data.why: All inputs (effect size, reliability, base rate, threshold) are entered via on-page sliders/number fields; no file upload or dataset loading exists in the interface.

goals: Interpret a reported effect size (Cohen's d, odds ratio, or Pearson's r) by translating it into real-world predictive performance (ROC-AUC, sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV) given a base rate and measurement reliability
Plan a study by determining what effect size or sample size is needed to achieve a target predictive performance
Estimate how measurement unreliability (ICC, kappa) attenuates an observed effect relative to the true effect
Estimate the combined predictive performance (ROC-AUC/PR-AUC) achievable from multiple correlated predictors using the Mahalanobis D or multiple R^2 calculators
Assess decision-curve net benefit across classification thresholds for a given effect size and base rate
Check how a model's calibration degrades when applied to a target population with different reliability or base rate than its development population

review.summary: The tree follows the README and paper well: it turns an effect size, reliability and base rate into predictive and clinical metrics, and it covers the planning extensions (number of predictors, sample size, calibration transfer). All ten screens I opened back their nodes. It needs a few fixes before filing: give the starting state for the threshold tasks the checker couldn't reproduce, add a base-rate task and a work-back-from-the-observed-effect task, merge the thin reliability phase into Interpret, and replay the calibration tasks.
